creator: MJB ADHD
provenance: Original coded vector layouts and wording; no third-party meme artwork

cards.title: One useful tab
cards.caption: One question can turn into several detours. This is a relatable exaggeration, not a diagnostic example.
cards.alt: Original two-panel meme: one browser tab becomes many tabs. Text: Me: One useful tab. The tabs: We invited friends.

cards.title: The missing start button
cards.caption: Wanting to act and getting started can feel very different. The image illustrates an experience, not a proven mechanism.
cards.alt: Original two-panel meme: a clear task plan beside a waiting start button. Text: The plan: Start the thing. The start button: Please wait.

cards.title: Just two minutes
cards.caption: A joke about losing track of time while absorbed. Experiences vary, and this image cannot identify ADHD.
cards.alt: Original two-panel meme: a clock labelled 10:00 becomes 12:00. Text: Me: Just two minutes. Time: That was a suggestion.
